'''Milosh Varta''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A member of the [[Exchange]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he lived with his wife [[Isbet Varta]] in [[Milosh Varta's estate|his estate]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was visited by [[Cipher Nine]], who looked for the [[Ghost cell]], and subsequently killed shortly after his wife met the same fate.<ref name="The Dragon's Tail" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the player chooses instead to earn Varta's cooperation, it can be gained through threatening him and/or his wife ([[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]), or negotiating protection and support ([[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]).<ref name="The Dragon's Tail" />
